intro: We’re a growing kitchen in Uyo and we’re always glad to hear from people who love food and good service.
howToApply: Send your CV and a short note about yourself to our email, with the role in the subject line.
openToAll: Don’t see a role that fits? Send your CV anyway and we’ll keep it on file.

positions.title: Line cook
positions.summary: Sample role. Prepare and cook menu items to recipe, keep your station clean and help the team hit order times.
requirements: At least 1 year in a busy kitchen

positions.title: Delivery rider
positions.summary: Sample role. Deliver orders around Uyo on time and keep customers updated.
